question: does classifying BOTH epochs with our CSF close the gen1-gen2 cover-dependent gap?

inputs.role: pipeline registration: bounds, resolution, applied shifts
gen2 ground surface as the pipeline has it = per-cell median of the VENDOR class-2 points (NOT our CSF)
gen2 returns classified by OUR CSF, same parameters as gen1
per-cell canopy cover fraction from PyForestScan plant-area density
DEM of difference, gen2 minus gen1, metres; + = elevation rose

params.name: slope_max
params.why: opened the slope cut from the repo default of 12 deg to take the whole CSF patch; this admits steep mass-wasting cells that the reference population is defined to exclude

masks.name: stable
masks.defn: reference_cells(slope_max=90.0) -- divide/curvature/building/clearcut cuts, slope cut effectively DISABLED

masks.name: ok
masks.defn: stable AND all three fields finite AND >=min_pts CSF ground points

columns.stratum: canopy cover bin, dimensionless fraction of PyForestScan cover
columns.cells: number of cells in the stratum, count
columns.z_csf-z_after: median over cells of (our CSF ground - vendor class-2 ground), mm, slope-normal
columns.DoD_now: median DoD as the pipeline reports it, mm, gen2-gen1

notes: reference_cells cuts: start=355600, not a divide cell=243595, |curv| > 0.015=12788, slope >= 90 deg=0, building returns=138, clear-cut (frac drop > 0.3)=1439, blufftop retreat margin=3262, |DoD| > 500 mm=1974, kept=92404
headline: cover-stratified CSF-minus-vendor gen2 ground offset
